snippet.title: Sherlock Holmes and The Hound of The Baskervilles Walkthrough part 1
snippet.description:
Sherlock Holmes and The Hound of The Baskervilles is a hidden object adventure game developed by Waterlily Games and published by Frogwares in 2010.

Help Sherlock Holmes, the famed detective, investigate the legend of a supernatural hound on the fog-shrouded moorland in England of the 19th century. Immerse yourself into the dangerous world of diabolical curse and discover the truth of the monstrous creature.

Thanks for watching :)
